io.name: clk
io.description: Clock; sample after posedge has settled.

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM. Outputs Y0 (bit 0 of next state Y[2:0]) and z are combinational functions of present state y[2:0] and input x. State transitions occur on posedge clk.
rules: Y0 = 1 iff (y==3'b000 and x==1) or (y==3'b001 and x==0) or (y==3'b010 and x==1) or (y==3'b011 and x==0); else Y0 = 0.
z = 1 iff y==3'b011 or y==3'b100; else z = 0.
Outputs are combinational (latency 0) and reflect the present state and current x before the sampled clock edge.
